_meta.what: The one table of what Social Media Factory can do. The start menu, `factory.py status` and GUIDE.md are all made from this file, so they cannot disagree.

states.needs setup: something has to be installed on this computer first
states.needs input: it needs something from you: a key, a brand, a file
states.unverified: a key is present but has not been checked online yet
states.blocked: a key was checked and the service refused it
states.not built yet: planned, not in this copy yet

needs.tiers: package groups that must be installed (core, video)
needs.keys: every key in the list is required
needs.optional_keys: {key: what it unlocks}: the feature works without it, and status and the guide say what it adds
needs.brand: true when a brand must exist under Client/
needs.checks: named functions in smf/checks.py that must pass

sections.name: Set up
sections.about: Install what this computer needs, add keys only for what you choose, and see what is ready.
sections.owner: Whoever looks after the computer. Once per computer, about ten minutes.

sections.name: Onboard a brand
sections.about: Teach the Social Media Factory who the brand is: what it does, who it talks to, how it sounds in its own words, its offers, colours, rules and accounts. Everything else is built on this.
sections.owner: The person who knows the brand best: the owner, or the account lead for a client.

sections.name: Decide what to talk about
sections.about: Topics come from the brand's own pillars, its audience's real questions, its offers and its proof. The person approves topics before anything is written. Research is there when you want to look outward.
sections.owner: A strategist or the owner. Weekly.

sections.name: Write
sections.about: Posts for each platform, short-form video scripts with teleprompter files, and long-form YouTube packages. Written from a brief built from the brand's own files, then checked against the platform's rules, the brand's rules and the brand's facts.
sections.owner: A writer or social media manager.

sections.name: Record and clip
sections.about: A recording becomes finished clips: transcript, the person's choice of moments, cuts made on the actual words, fillers tightened, captioned versions, a description for each.

sections.name: Make visuals
sections.about: Carousels, cards and PDFs drawn on this computer in the brand's colours. No account and no photos needed.

sections.name: Approve
sections.about: One page, on your own computer, with every post and picture. Approve, edit, turn down or ask for a remake. Approval is of exact words and pictures.
sections.owner: Whoever signs off: the owner, the client, a compliance lead.

sections.name: Post
sections.about: Schedule approved posts to the brand's accounts, or save a ready-to-post folder and upload by hand. Always a preview first; nothing is sent without a yes.

sections.name: Check results
sections.about: Did it really go out, and how did it do. Keeps a permanent copy of the numbers on your computer.
sections.owner: A social media manager or analyst. Weekly.

features.name: Set up this computer
features.output: A working Social Media Factory on this computer, and a self-test that proves each piece by using it.

features.name: See what is ready
features.output: A plain list of what works now and the next step for anything that does not.

features.name: Onboard or update a brand
say: set up my brand on a page
features.output: A brand folder: settings, the brand's own words, brand kit, rules, a proof library, and a checklist of only the accounts its choices need.

features.name: Plan topics from the brand
features.output: Approved topics, each pointing at where in the brand's material it came from, and a plan: a different angle per platform, a job for each post, a visual kind, an ending.

features.name: Talking points with web research
say: prep me for a podcast about ...
features.output: A run-sheet of talking points, every number with a named source and a link.

features.name: Research what is working
say: pull the facts out of this video
features.output: Creator studies, YouTube demand and outliers, Reddit and X listening, demand reports, search results, a mined video. The cost is shown before every run.

features.name: Write posts for each platform
features.output: A batch of posts in the brand's voice, each checked against the platform's rules, the brand's rules and the brand's facts, planned across days so no two accounts repeat a subject.

features.name: Write short-form video scripts
say: write me ten short video scripts
features.output: Scripts with a text, visual and spoken hook that agree, visual directions, a teleprompter file for each, a batch index to film from, and an audit of results.

features.name: Package a long-form YouTube video
features.output: A folder per video: title options, thumbnail, hook, structure, description with chapters, a slide deck and a teleprompter file.

features.name: Turn a recording into clips
features.output: A transcript with who said what, a cut list of moments you chose, rough cuts, fine cuts, and a check that every clip holds the right words.

features.name: Captioned versions and descriptions
say: make versions for my other accounts
features.output: Several different-looking versions of each clip with on-screen text, word-by-word captions and any disclaimer, a description for each, checked before delivery.

features.name: Switch between two cameras automatically
say: I filmed this on two cameras
features.output: One edited video that cuts to whoever is speaking, and clips from it.

features.name: Cut a narrated film from many sources
say: make a video ad from my footage
cut these clips to a voiceover
turn my brand story into a film
features.output: A film whose every shot is matched to a line of narration (a synthesised voice or your own read), drafted from your own onboarding answers or a finished script and cut from the footage folder in your brand, with an optional music bed (a track you have the rights to, the built-in quiet bed, or one made to order from your brand's own settings), a contact sheet taken from the finished film, and a credits list for every source.

optional_keys.ELEVENLABS_API_KEY: voicing the narration and a music bed made to order (your own recorded read and the built-in bed need no key)

features.name: Motion titles in your brand's colours
say: make an opening title and an end card
features.output: A short title clip for every piece of on-screen text a film's plan already carries (its title, each line's words on screen, your wordmark and handle), drawn in your own colours, fonts and logo with one simple entrance and exit, added to the plan as a source you place like any other shot. Drawn on this computer by HyperFrames, which setup installs with the video tools.

features.name: Make carousels and cards
features.output: Carousels, stat cards, before-and-after, alert, headline, note, post-style and bold text cards, plus PDFs, in the brand's colours.

features.name: Make an AI picture
say: make a picture of a warm loaf on a floured board
generate a photo for this post
features.output: One picture made to order with your own OpenAI key, saved to the brand's pictures. An estimated cost is shown and you say yes before each one.

features.name: Review and approve on this computer
features.output: One page with every post and picture. Nothing leaves the computer.

features.name: Save a ready-to-post folder
say: save them so I can post by hand
features.output: A dated folder with each approved post's words and pictures in posting order, a schedule sheet and a plain read-me.

features.name: Schedule through Metricool
features.output: Approved posts scheduled to the brand's linked accounts, after a preview and a yes.

features.name: One short a day from a folder of videos
say: I have new shorts to schedule
features.output: Finished videos planned one per day per account, carrying on after what is already booked.

features.name: Test on TikTok, promote the winner (advanced, off by default)
features.output: Every version of a clip goes to TikTok first; the best one is scheduled to the other accounts after you say yes. It posts the same clip several times on purpose.

features.name: Did my posts go out, and how did they do
features.output: Posts the networks refused and why, the numbers for the ones that went out, and a permanent local copy of those numbers.

features.name: Results for posts you put up by hand
features.output: Posts from your ready-to-post folder, with the links and numbers you give, counted in the summary and marked as typed in. Nothing is estimated.
